description: Enable or disable the change protection of an RRSet. Enabling is immediate; DISABLING removes the last safeguard against delete_rrset and set_records and therefore needs a confirm_token.

change.description: true to protect the RRSet from changes and deletion, false to unprotect

confirm_token.description: Confirmation token from the previous call of this same tool with identical arguments. Omit on the first call — the server then returns a token that is valid for a few minutes.

name.description: Name of the RRSet, relative to the zone and in lower case, e.g. "www" or "@" for the zone apex

type.description: Type of the RRSet, e.g. "A" or "TXT"

zone.description: ID or name of the zone, e.g. "example.com"

name: change_rrset_protection
title: Change RRSet protection
